I have normal to dry skin and get a few breakouts here and there. My skin isn't sensitive; it usually tolerates new products well. This cleanser has no artificial fragrance, which I appreciate, and because it's a foaming formula, it feels light on the skin. It rinses easily without leaving behind any residue, and it doesn't overly strip my skin, which I was worried about because it's made more for people with oily skin, my skin didn't feel dry or tight after use. The instructions say to use twice daily, but I felt that would be too drying for my skin, so I started by using it every other night, working up to once daily at night. (I also don't like using so many acids during the day) I can't say that I saw a difference in the few breakouts I get a month but as an exfoliating cleanser I think it did a good job, it was great at breaking down sunscreen and left over makeup removing balm. I didn't have any 'purging', and as long as I used a hydrating moisturizer, my skin was overall happy. The reason I'm only giving the three stars is because I don't think I can fairly judge how it will work on the oily skin and/or skin with acne that it's made for. avis.titre: Too strong to be used as directed
avis.texte: Definetly great for getting impurities off your face, but personally way too harsh for daily use. You'll need an intense moisturizer and serum to accompany this cleanser. I practically dried my skin to smithereens using it as directed. Using a gentler cleanser daily and this one once every other evening seems to be the spot for me. Sensitive skin types should be wary.
Myself and my daughter use this and it helps with cleaning our faces and has helped with breakouts!

I have normal/combination skin.. Some days i'm really oily… others.. its combination. I like everything i've tried by exuviance. The aha cleanser was out at my store, I picked this one instead. It totally works fine. I leave it in the shower. Husband has super dry skin and uses it on occasion. It doesn't overly dry his skin. He probably doesnt use it enough for it to. This did not break me out. It did not overly dry my skin. It melts all makeup nicely.
I decided to try this 3 in 1 product since the Deep Clean AHA Cleanser was out of stock. The product was extremely strong for my combination skin. Returned.
